figurative_meaning_bn: কড়া ও নরম, ভালো ও মন্দ মিশ্রিত সম্পর্ক
figurative_meaning_en: A relationship mixed with harsh and gentle, good and bad elements
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাদের দাম্পত্য জীবন অম্লমধুর সম্পর্কের মতো।
example_sentences_in_english: Their marital life is like a bittersweet relationship.
The friendship has turned into a bittersweet bond.
note: This idiom draws from the sensory contrast of flavors, common in Bengali poetic expressions of human relations.
